b-site.basis: Game metres (x, y, z). The valorant-api callout (18.85, -92.31, z 7.00) sits on the ROOF of the site's central structure: objects Terminal_0_BombSiteBUnit / Terminal_0_BombsiteBUnitB (footprint x 14.0..24.0 m, y -96.0..-89.0 m, walls z 3.03..7.00 m, top 7.01 m). That roof is a 10 m x 7 m walkable island of 267 grid cells, 4.0 m above the site floor Floor_17_BsiteGrateFloor (z 3.00 m): nothing walks onto it, so the zone could only be left by a drop. The site floor itself is open and on the main walk component all the way round the structure. Anchor = the standable site-floor cell nearest the callout: 2.89 m away in x,y, in the corner between the two blocks on the Mid Courtyard side. Alternatives measured (zone visibility to mid-courtyard / b-back / c-link, walk metres to mid-courtyard / b-back): this cell 0.24 / 0.05 / 0.04, 24.4 / 22.0; front centre (18.68, -88.40) 0.23 / 0.01 / 0.00, 22.0 / 24.8; back centre (18.68, -96.40) 0.01 / 0.63 / 0.25, 36.7 / 12.6; west side (13.18, -92.40) 0.37 / 0.13 / 0.07, 27.8 / 17.2; east side (24.68, -92.40) 0.00 / 0.32 / 0.08, 28.5 / 16.6. The structure hides one half of the site from any single point.
